# Lingua Tales persistent GitHub instructions

Follow AGENTS.md; authoritative user requirements and stable IDs live in docs/LINGUA_TALES_MASTER_PLAN.md. Actual implemented/remaining, exact HEAD and CI are documented in docs/LINGUA_TALES_LIVE_STATUS.md. Real historically sourced book and rights queue: docs/LITERATURE_SOURCE_QUEUE.md.

On every development turn: check current PR #1 HEAD/actions/commits, do not redo existing work, implement highest unmet requirement with real tests, update LIVE_STATUS in **the same commit**. No new AI-authored fiction, juvenile retellings, small stories or generic modern-looking art; broad mature classic full volumes, including complete Arabic original + full natural contextual English heritage translations. Vintage in-page illustrations, title-bearing covers, water bubble feedback, authentic page curl, performance and safe production updates. Never merge main or pretend Debug Preview updates production.
